name: Queen Linden of Ardenvale
description: The High King's wife and stepmother of the twins, who revives Algenus's twins and later returns him to life.

description_citations.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
description_citations.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Three months later Rowan and Will decide to quest for their father, joined by Titus and Cerise.
timeline.quote: Rowan and Will decide to start on a quest to find their father, and Titus and Cerise join them.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Wild Hunt a figure looking like Queen Ayara mortally wounds the stag with an arrow.
timeline.quote: A brawl ensues, which ends with a person looking like Queen Ayara shooting the stag with an arrow and mortally wounding it.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The dying stag transforms back into Algenus Kenrith.
timeline.quote: As it dies, it transforms back into the form of Algenus Kenrith.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Linden reveals the witch fed Algenus a love potion, and Algenus killed her.
timeline.quote: The witch had fed Algenus a love potion that had stolen his memory and his heart.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Linden uses the sword's life to return Algenus to the living; Rowan's spark ignites and she and Will vanish.
timeline.quote: As there is still life in Algenus' sword from the well, Linden uses it to return him to the world of the living.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: If you're as loyal as you claim, now is the time to show it.

citation.text: Rally for the Throne (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Linden revived him with a true love's kiss.
relations.quote: Linden had returned Algenus to his senses with a true love's kiss

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest

pages_say.description: Queen of Ardenvale who vows to defend the realm until her last breath and calls for loyalty to the throne.
